id.description: The ID of the access control rule to upsert on.

operation.description: The operation to grant access to.  This could be a read, write, delete, etc.  Please see the access controls list specification for all operations and their descriptions.

resource.description:
The resource to grant access to.  This could be an endpoint, a flow, a secret, etc.  You can define this as either a class of resources, or a specific resource. 
Examples: - port1/users/alice/endpoints/thermostat-zero grants access to that thermostat - port1/users/alice/flows/* grants access to all flows owned by alice

identity.description:
The identity to grant access to. This could be a user, a role, a group, etc. You can define this as either a class of identities, or a specific identity.
Examples: - port1/account/john/users/alice grants access to alice - port1/account/john/users/* grants access to all users owned by john - * just grants access to all identities
